name: Sera Dawnwarden

ac.type: Splint 17 + shield 2; Dueling is damage, not AC

proficiencies: All armor, shields, simple/martial weapons. Half-elf skills Perception and Intimidation; class Athletics and Persuasion; background Insight and Religion. Dueling fighting style.
bio:
A former temple prosecutor who broke with corrupt elders after discovering their secret prison. Sera directs her zeal against coercive cults and their tyrants, not ordinary worshippers. Bond: free the remaining prisoners. Flaw: hears uncertainty as a challenge to her resolve.

Enter 158 gp. Add global +4 saving throw modifier for Aura of Protection only while conscious and active; switch it off while unconscious, including your own death saves. Against the current Heretic target only, manually treat 19 as a critical. Track 35 Lay on Hands HP and one Channel Divinity use per short rest.

Remaining gold: 158 gp. See the companion build guide for full progression, equipment ledger and feature timing.

traits.name: Build audit
traits.description: 2014 Paladin 7. Standard array Str/Dex/Con/Int/Wis/Cha: 8/12/14/10/13/15. Half-elf +2 Cha/+1 Con/+1 Wis; Paladin 4 +1 Cha/+1 Con. Belt sets native Str 8 to 21. Native stats: 8/12/16/10/14/18. Equipped stats: 21/12/16/10/14/18. HP 67: first Hit Die maximum, six fixed average increases and Constitution at all seven levels.

traits.name: Campaign constraints
traits.description: Background Acolyte is the original PHB version and grants no feat. House-rule starting feat: Polearm Master, which gives no ability-score increase. Any racial half-feat is a separate racial choice, not the house feat. One rare and one uncommon magic item only. Additional 638 gp plus 15 gp background money; purchases 495 gp; remaining 158 gp. No resale or pre-existing summons assumed.

traits.name: Half-elf advancement
traits.description: Racial +2 Charisma, +1 Constitution, +1 Wisdom. Paladin 4 adds +1 Charisma and +1 Constitution: native Con 16, Cha 18, Wis 14. House feat Polearm Master grants no stat increase. Darkvision 60 feet; advantage on saves against charm; magic cannot put you to sleep.

traits.name: Belt and equipment dependency
traits.description: Belt sets native Strength 8 to 21. With it, splint's Strength requirement is met and speed remains 30 feet. Without the belt, reduce Strength and apply the heavy-armor speed penalty. Attunement: one slot used.

traits.name: Dueling and Polearm Master
traits.description: Wield +1 quarterstaff in ONE hand and a shield in the other. Dueling adds +2 damage; a shield is not a second weapon. Attack action makes two 1d6+8 attacks; qualifying bonus action makes one 1d4+8 shaft attack. PAM can also trigger an opportunity attack when a creature enters the staff's 5-foot reach.

traits.name: Mark of the Heretic
traits.description: Channel Divinity, bonus action: mark a visible creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. Your weapon attacks against it crit on 19 or 20. When ITS turn starts, you may use your reaction to make ONE weapon attack against it, provided normal weapon range/reach permits. Does not grant extra reactions, movement or advantage.

traits.name: Inquisitor's Eye
traits.description: Alternate Channel Divinity, bonus action: for 10 minutes gain advantage on Investigation, Insight and Perception checks and cannot be surprised. Shares the same one-per-rest Channel Divinity pool with Mark of the Heretic.

traits.name: Aura of Clarity
traits.description: At Paladin 7, while conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet cannot be blinded. Chosen creatures/objects in that range cannot benefit from invisibility. Does not reveal things outside the aura.

traits.name: Aura of Protection
traits.description: While conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet add Charisma +4 to saving throws, including your concentration saves. AFTER IMPORT add an enabled global +4 save modifier while conscious. Base displayed saves omit the aura. Disable it when unconscious; it does NOT add +4 to your own ordinary death saves.

traits.name: Divine Smite
traits.description: After a melee weapon hit, optionally spend a slot: 2d8 radiant for 1st level, 3d8 for 2nd, plus 1d8 against undead/fiends. It is a feature, not a bonus-action spell in 2014. Dice double on critical hits. Do not add smite to every attack without spending slots.

traits.name: Paladin resources
traits.description: Lay on Hands 35 HP per long rest; can spend 5 to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. Divine Sense 5 uses per long rest. Channel Divinity 1 per short/long rest. Divine Health grants disease immunity. Seven prepared paladin spells plus four always-prepared oath spells; slots 4/3.

traits.name: Hunter's Mark and action economy
traits.description: The spell adds 1d6 to each weapon hit but requires concentration and its own bonus action to cast/move. Mark of the Heretic is a different, non-spell feature. You cannot cast Hunter's Mark and use the PAM bonus attack on the same turn. One reaction must be shared between Heretic attacks and opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Spellcasting hands
traits.description: The shield can bear your holy symbol for spells using an unpriced nonconsumed material component. Without War Caster, stow the staff to provide a free hand for somatic-only spells such as Cure Wounds. Plan object interactions; do not assume the PAM house feat solves spell components.

traits.name: Harness Divine Power
traits.description: Optional Tasha feature: bonus action, spend your one shared Channel Divinity use to recover an expended 1st- or 2nd-level spell slot. At Paladin 7 this feature is limited to twice per LONG rest, even if short rests refresh Channel Divinity. It competes with Mark of the Heretic for the shared resource.

attacks.name: +1 Quarterstaff — one-handed Dueling
attacks.description: Strength 5 + magic 1 + Dueling 2. Add smite or Hunter's Mark only if actually used.

attacks.name: PAM staff shaft
attacks.description: Bonus action after qualifying Attack action. Dueling applies.

attacks.name: Marked target — 19–20 critical
attacks.description: Use critical range 19 only against the active Mark of the Heretic target; the importer defaults to 20, so flag 19s manually.

attacks.name: Javelin — thrown with shield
attacks.description: Dueling applies when only the javelin is wielded with the shield. Stow the staff before switching weapons; respect object interactions.

equipment.name: Chain Mail
equipment.description: Free starting armor; spare, NOT worn.

equipment.name: Priest's Pack
equipment.description: Free class pack; contents included in weight.

equipment.name: Holy symbol
equipment.description: Free class focus; display on the shield.

equipment.name: Acolyte equipment
equipment.description: Gift holy symbol, prayer book, 5 incense sticks, vestments, common clothes and pouch. Background 15 gp is included in cash.

equipment.name: Splint Armor
equipment.description: Purchased: 200 gp each; 200 gp total. Worn; AC 17 plus shield 2. Belt meets Strength requirement.

equipment.name: Gold coins
equipment.description: 158 gp remaining; set the sheet gold counter to this amount. This row is the same money, not extra.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saving throws. Concentration; cannot combine with Hunter's Mark or Shield of Faith.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: Touch a living creature; restore 1d8+4 HP, with another 1d8 per slot level above 1st. Use the 2014 healing amount.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: Bonus action; target gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes with concentration. Not active on the starting sheet. Conflicts with other bonus actions and concentration spells.
spells.materials: a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it

spells.name: Command
spells.description: DC 15 Wisdom save; give a one-word command to a creature that understands your language. Undead and directly harmful commands are unaffected. No concentration.

spells.name: Aid
spells.description: Prepared paladin spell. Up to three creatures gain 5 current and maximum HP for 8 hours, +5 per slot level above 2nd. Not temporary HP and no concentration. Not pre-applied to the sheet.
spells.materials: a tiny strip of white cloth

spells.name: Find Steed
spells.description: Summon an eligible spirit steed, such as a warhorse. It persists until dismissed or reduced to 0 HP. Use the 2014 mount and spell-sharing rules; no steed is assumed already summoned in the import.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: Touch a creature and end one disease or one instance of blindness, deafness, paralysis, or poisoning.

spells.name: Detect Evil and Good
spells.description: Oath spell. For up to 10 minutes, sense listed supernatural creature types within 30 feet and consecrated/desecrated places or objects, subject to barrier limits. Concentration.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: Oath spell. Bonus action; mark a visible creature within 90 feet and add 1d6 to each weapon hit against it. Advantage on Perception/Survival checks to find it. Move the mark with a later bonus action after it drops to 0 HP. Concentration. This is separate from the Channel Divinity Mark of the Heretic.

spells.name: Detect Thoughts
spells.description: Oath spell. Read surface thoughts and optionally probe deeper using the full spell's Wisdom save and contest rules. Concentration. Uses spell DC 15.

spells.name: Knock
spells.description: Oath spell. Open one eligible lock, bar or magical Arcane Lock suppression. Makes a loud sound audible up to 300 feet away; not a stealth solution.
